name: Mama Mahjong
source:
On the day their two sons left for an overnight study, Naoko and Youko held a dinner party at the Hobara household to relax and have some fun together.

A woman came to the party, Rie Funaoka, a junior colleague of Naoko from her days as an office worker.

The party is a charming and enjoyable one, the drinks are flowing and before they know it, they are discussing the possibility of playing mahjong. To make up for the lack of players, Rie's brother-in-law, Tadashi, was summoned with a single phone call.

Youko comes up with a killer idea to inspire Tadashi who is a ronin, and the idea is stripe mahjong!

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmmj.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
两个儿子外出参加住宿学习的那天，直子和洋子在保原家举办晚餐聚会，准备一起放松娱乐。

一名女子来到聚会现场，她叫船冈理惠，是直子上班族时期的后辈同事。

聚会轻松愉快，酒也越喝越多。不知不觉间，众人谈起了打麻将。由于人数不足，理惠只打了一通电话，便把姐夫正叫了过来。

为了激励身为复读生的正，洋子想出了一个绝妙主意——脱衣麻将！

[摘自[url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmmj.html]官方网站[/url]]
